data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 – refund of €550
data.summary: Finanzamt Beispielstadt issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 on 27 February 2026. Tax is set at €8,990.00 and, after €9,540.00 of wage tax already withheld, you get a refund of €550.00.
data.explanation: This is your tax assessment for 2025. The tax office found you overpaid through wage tax withholding, so €550 will be credited to your account. Check that the figures match your return and wage tax certificate. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the tax office; the app shows the deadline. If you accept it, no action is needed. A tax adviser can help if you are unsure.
data.tax_note: Income tax assessment for 2025; craftsman services (§ 35a EStG) were accepted. Keep it for your records.
